description:
JOYSTAR Angel Girls Bike with T
raining Wheels & Basket - 12" to 18"
Bring a touch of vintage charm to your child’s outdoor adventures with the JOYSTAR Angel Girls Bike. Designed with a classic aesthetic and modern safety features, this bike is specifically engineered for girls aged 2-9 to build confidence and joy on two wheels. From the adorable front basket to the sturdy training wheels, every detail is crafted to make their first pedal bike experience unforgettable.

The perfect vintage ride: JOYSTAR Angel featuring a classic woven basket and stable training wheels.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Safety is at the heart of the Angel series. We’ve engineered this bike to be as reliable as it is beautiful, featuring intuitive braking and shock-proof construction."
Safer Riding Features
The Angel is equipped with a dual-braking system: a rear coaster brake for intuitive stopping by pedaling backward and a front caliper brake to help older children transition to hand brakes. The Hi-Ten Steel frame provides a durable, shock-proof foundation that survives the bumps of learning.

Fully enclosed chain guard and intuitive braking systems for maximum protection.

Child-Friendly Ergonomics

Dual Brakes: Rear coaster/foot brake and front handbrake for ample stopping power.

Protection: Fully enclosed chain guard prevents contact with moving parts and keeps clothes clean.

Stability: Heavy-duty training wheels provide the balance needed for beginners to find their footing.

Adjustability: Quick-release saddle and stem allow the bike to grow with your child.

Quick & Easy Assembly
We know you want to get riding fast. The JOYSTAR Angel arrives 85% pre-assembled. Within 20 minutes, you’ll have the front wheel, seat, handlebars, and pedals installed and ready to go. All necessary assembly tools and easy-to-follow instructions are included in the box.

See It In Action

Our Guarantee
Your purchase is protected by our Limited Lifetime Warranty on the frame. Our US-based customer service team is ready to help with replacement parts or assembly questions.
